name: excalidraw-live
description: Live agent-editable Excalidraw canvas with persistent scenes, images and snapshots. Packages yctimlin/mcp_excalidraw (MIT), unchanged, plus a stdio MCP launcher. One shared scene; coordinate concurrent editors. No authentication. Default port binds to server loopback and requires an SSH tunnel for browser access. MCP connects through SSH and docker exec -i; port 3000 is browser/REST/WebSocket, not HTTP MCP. Runs as UID 99/GID 100 with a read-only root filesystem. See install instructions before changing exposure.
